Subject: Hosted evaluation: quickstart & endpoint / rate alignment

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) What we heard from you
- Primary goal: integrate Gen-A summarization and retrieval-augmented responses into your support workflows.
- Preferred starting mode: Hosted API (low-friction) unless sustained production traffic suggests Dedicated later.
- Expected shapes: average ~3 RPS across business hours, bursty spikes to ~15 RPS for short periods, and roughly 500–700k tokens/day at peak.

2) Proposed Hosted quickstart (what we can provision this week)
- Sandbox (staging) API keys and a single sandbox endpoint (sandbox-us.redwood.ai) for 48h perf tests.
- Two endpoint mappings: /summarize (short response model) and /chat-aug (RAG with retrieval prefetch).
- Rate guard suggestion: start with 10 RPS sustained, 50 RPS burst ceiling in trial tier; we can tune after the 48h run.

3) Ops & security notes
- We’ll enable token-level usage logs for your security team to validate.
- If you require VPC or HIPAA controls we can surface Private deployment options — likely required only if you move to on-prem or retention-sensitive workflows.

4) Next actions (owner in parentheses)
- I’ll provision sandbox keys and endpoints (soojin).
- Karthik, can you propose a short perf script and baseline metrics we should collect (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec)? (karthik)
- Ben, I’ll hand to you for trial pricing and rate carve-outs for procurement. (ben)
- Alex, please confirm the traffic profile above and attach any compliance docs you want us to validate.

Attachments: [Attachment: pilot_scope.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]

Thanks — plan to provision sandbox this afternoon if you confirm.

Best,

- Peak day last month was ~620k tokens; planning conservatively for 700k tokens/day in pilot.
